# THS Computer Science Club

> The Computer Science Club at James E. Taylor High School (JET), creating the next generation of coders.

- [Home](https://thscompsci.com/): Overview and social links

- [Blog](https://thscompsci.com/blog): Blog Posts made by members of the THS CS Club!
